rules.title: Berkeley Municipal Code ch. 13.63 - Algorithmic Rent Pricing Prohibition
rules.requirement: Berkeley bans landlords from using coordinated algorithmic pricing tools to set or recommend rents, and tenants may bring private claims with recurring per-unit, per-month violations.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to landlords of multifamily rental units in Berkeley using coordinated pricing algorithms or revenue-management software.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits coordinated pricing algorithms; recurring unit/month violations and private remedies, previously at issue in RealPage, Inc. v. City of Berkeley et al., (N.D. Cal.) (voluntarily dismissed with prejudice Jan. 14, 2026).
